hero.title: ABOUT US
hero.description: GAMAC ENERGY was born from a strong belief: the future belongs to renewable energy. We innovate every day to make clean energy accessible and efficient. Our mission: to build a sustainable future for today's and tomorrow's generations.

navigation.mot_du_dg: A Word from the Managing Director

historic.subtitle: Energy for businesses
historic.title: Products and services for long-term partnerships
historic.description_1: Founded in March 2023 in the Democratic Republic of Congo,
historic.description_3: is much more than an engineering company: it is a driver of energy transformation. We operate at the crossroads of renewable and conventional energies, with a clear objective: to provide solutions that address today’s energy challenges in Africa and build tomorrow’s resilience. Our expertise covers the entire value chain – from design to construction, including maintenance and optimization. This integrated approach allows us to deliver concrete, measurable and sustainable results.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description_1: is to become a leading player and strategic partner in the energy sector in the Democratic Republic of Congo and across Africa, by providing integrated and sustainable solutions that cover the entire energy value chain. As a provider of physical works, intellectual services and specialized equipment and materials, we strive to offer high-level expertise and modern technologies to strengthen national electrical infrastructure. Our vision is also to actively contribute to improving access to reliable, safe and affordable energy for all, while supporting the economic growth and sustainable development of the DRC.

hero.title: OUR MISSION
hero.title_description_1: Innovation in the service of clean energy.
hero.description: We are proud to build local solutions that contribute to the energy sovereignty of our country.

missions.title: PROVIDING RELIABLE AND ACCESSIBLE ENERGY
missions.description: Our first mission is to guarantee reliable, continuous and competitive energy for our clients, whether they are industrial, institutional or community-based. We design and deploy solutions tailored to local needs, combining modern technologies with field expertise. From feasibility studies to maintenance, we support every step to deliver energy that drives growth, stimulates the economy and improves quality of life for communities.

missions.title: DEVELOPING LOCAL TALENT AND STRENGTHENING SKILLS
missions.description: Our third mission is to make every energy project an opportunity for human development. We are committed to training, employing and supporting local talent in order to build a skilled workforce proud to contribute to the energy sovereignty of the Democratic Republic of Congo and the African continent.

missions.title: INNOVATING FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT
missions.description: Our second mission is to be a responsible innovation partner, integrating into our projects solutions that promote the energy transition and reduce the carbon footprint. We believe that Africa’s future lies in infrastructure capable of combining performance, safety and sustainability. Through rural electrification, the development of renewable energies and the modernization of existing facilities, we turn each project into a lever for inclusive development across the continent.

hero.title: OUR SERVICES
hero.title_description_1: For a greener future, starting today.
hero.description: We support our clients and partners in the successful delivery of energy projects in electricity, hydraulics and downstream oil. Our expertise covers all key stages: from design to commissioning, with end-to-end technical and strategic support.

hero.title: PROVIDERS OF INTELLECTUAL SERVICES
hero.subtitle: For a greener future, starting now.

services.title: Pre-feasibility & Feasibility Studies
items: Pre-feasibility studies (site screening, preliminary analyses).
Technical, economic and financial feasibility studies.
Grid connection and integration studies (load flow, stability, short-circuit).
Hydrological, geotechnical and environmental studies for hydraulic projects.
Market analyses and financial modelling for downstream oil projects.
Environmental and social impact reports (EIA/ESIA).

services.title: Design & Engineering
items: Preliminary, basic and detailed design of energy infrastructure:
Power plants (hydropower, thermal, solar, hybrid).
Transmission and distribution networks (substations, HV/MV/LV lines).
Hydraulic infrastructure (dams, intake structures, penstocks, canals).
Storage and distribution facilities in downstream oil (depots, fuel stations, pipelines).
Sizing of electromechanical and civil engineering equipment.
Preparation of drawings, technical diagrams and execution files.

services.title: Consulting & Technical Assistance – Supervision, Monitoring & Control
items: Strategic consulting in planning and management of energy projects.
Support with administrative procedures (environment, safety).
Assistance in preparing tenders and bids.
Supervision and monitoring of electrical, hydromechanical and oil-related works.
Quality control of materials, equipment and on-site execution.
Verification of compliance with international norms and standards.
HSE monitoring and performance of tests, commissioning and start-up.

hero.title: PROVIDERS OF PHYSICAL WORKS
hero.subtitle: For a greener future, starting now.

construction: Distribution networks and drinking water boreholes and pumping systems
maintenance: Preventive and corrective maintenance of solar/hydro/thermal power plants
Modifications & extensions: Replacement or modernization of pumps (manual to electric/solar)
Extension of the distribution network from an existing borehole
Addition of extra storage systems (tanks, reservoirs)
mise aux normes: Compliance with national and international standards (WHO, ISO, health standards)
Installation of water quality monitoring systems
rénovation: Rehabilitation of ageing power plants, substations and networks
Rehabilitation of old or abandoned boreholes
Restoration of pumping and distribution systems
dépose: Out-of-service pumping equipment or non-functional equipment

services.title: Oil & Gas
items: Construction and maintenance of oil depots compliant with international standards.
Deployment and management of pipelines with advanced monitoring systems.
Integration of automation solutions for safety and efficiency.
Development of innovative, flexible and cost-effective micro-modular refineries.

main.title: Privacy Policy – Bigemip
main.description: At Bigemip, we attach paramount importance to the protection of your personal data and your privacy. This Privacy Policy aims to explain to you clearly and transparently:

list.item_1: What data we collect
list.item_2: How and why we use it
list.item_3: The measures we put in place to protect it
list.item_4: The rights you have regarding your information

main.detail: By using our services, you accept the terms described below.

content_1.title: 1. Data we collect
content_1.description: We only collect the data necessary to provide and improve our services:

list.item_1: Personal information: first name, last name, email address, phone number, position, company.
list.item_2: Technical information: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, time spent.
list.item_3: Communication data: email exchanges, filled-in forms, messages sent via our platforms.
list.item_4: Contractual data: information related to invoicing, means of payment, order or service history.

content_1.detail: By using our services, you accept the terms described below.

content_2.title: 2. Purposes of data use
content_2.description: Your data is collected and used solely for the following purposes:

list.item_1: Providing and improving our services and solutions
list.item_2: Managing your requests, registrations and projects
list.item_3: Personalizing your user experience
list.item_4: Communicating with you (information, offers, newsletters, events)
list.item_5: Ensuring administrative, legal and financial follow-up
list.item_6: Preventing and detecting fraud or malicious activities

content_3.title: 3. Sharing your data
content_3.description: We do not sell or rent your data to third parties. However, your information may be shared in the following cases only:

list.item_1: Trusted partners: when necessary to provide the service (e.g., technical providers, hosting providers).
list.item_2: Legal obligations: when required by judicial or regulatory authorities.
list.item_3: Secure transfers: when using third-party tools (such as Google Workspace, LinkedIn or other software used in our activities), provided that these services offer an adequate level of data protection.

content_4.title: 4. Security and protection
content_4.description: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against:

list.item_1: Unauthorized access
list.item_2: Loss, leaks or theft
list.item_3: Accidental alterations or destruction

content_5.title: 5. Data retention
content_5.description: Your data is kept only for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described above, then deleted or anonymized. Some information may be kept longer in order to comply with our legal and tax obligations.

content_6.title: 6. Your rights
content_6.description: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

list.item_1: Access: know what data we hold about you
list.item_2: Rectification: correct your information if it is inaccurate or incomplete
list.item_3: Deletion: request the deletion of your personal data
list.item_4: Objection: object to the use of your data for certain purposes (marketing, prospecting)
list.item_5: Portability: obtain a copy of your data in a readable format
list.item_6: Restriction: limit the processing of your data in certain cases

content_7.title: 7. Cookies and similar technologies
content_7.description: Our site may use cookies and tracking tools in order to:

list.item_1: Facilitate your browsing
list.item_2: Measure audience and improve user experience
list.item_3: Customize content and offers

content_7.detail: You can configure your browser to refuse cookies or to notify you when they are being used.

content_8.title: 8. Changes to this policy
content_8.description: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices, our services or applicable legislation. The most recent version will always be available on this page.

baseMap.title: BASE GEOLOGICAL MAP
baseMap.description: With strong experience in applied geology and geo-informatics, BIGEMIP SARL supports mining sector operators in the production and updating of reliable, accurate geological maps that comply with international standards.
points: Regional and local geological maps illustrating lithological formations and stratigraphic units.
Structural maps highlighting major tectonic features, folds and faults.
Metallogenic maps showing the distribution of known mineral substances and areas with potential.

geoScientific.title: THEMATIC GEOSCIENTIFIC MAPS
points: Inventory maps of mineral indices and deposits.
Maps of mining and energy infrastructure to facilitate sector planning.

mining.title: MINING AND RESOURCE INVENTORY MAPS
points: Hydrogeological maps identifying groundwater aquifers and recharge areas.
Geotechnical maps describing soil nature and stability for infrastructure works.
Geophysical maps (magnetic, gravimetric, radiometric) for interpreting deep structures.
Regional geochemical maps highlighting trace element anomalies.
Soil and morpho-structural maps linking geology, relief and land use.
